for t in arq sparql riot java node npm; do printf "%s: " "$t"; command -v $t || echo none; done
echo "---apt---"

echo "---py---"
python3 -c "import ensurepip" 2>&1 | tail -1 || true
python3 --version
id; command -v sudo curl wget; echo "---"; ls /usr/bin | grep -iE 'pip|curl|wget|uv' | head

env | grep -iE 'proxy|pypi|index' || echo "no proxy env"
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, json
try:
    d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://pypi.org/pypi/pip/json", timeout=20))
    print("pip latest", d["info"]["version"])
    print("url sample", d["urls"][0]["url"] if d["urls"] else "no urls")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", repr(e))
PY

mkdir -p /tmp/pipwhl
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, json, zipfile, io, os
d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://pypi.org/pypi/pip/json", timeout=20))
url=[u for u in d["urls"] if u["packagetype"]=="bdist_wheel" and "py3-none-any" in u["filename"]][0]["url"]
print("downloading", url)
data=urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=60).read()
print("bytes", len(data))
open("/tmp/pip.whl","wb").write(data)
with zipfile.ZipFile("/tmp/pip.whl") as z: z.extractall("/tmp/pipwhl")
print("extracted")
PY
PYTHONPATH=/tmp/pipwhl python3 -m pip --version

set -e
